definition: App coverage means every product app under apps/ has at least one deterministic E2E smoke or journey that proves the built app can start and expose its core contract. The root e2e/ workspace is the harness and is intentionally outside the product app inventory.

apps.title: Desktop Electron app
apps.rationale: Launches the built Electron app and drives real renderer/main-process behavior through Playwright.

apps.title: Marketing web app
apps.rationale: Builds the static web export, serves it over HTTP, and asserts the landing route content.

apps.title: Docs app
apps.rationale: Builds the static docs export, serves it over HTTP, and asserts every exported docs content route.

apps.title: ShipCode CLI
apps.rationale: Builds the CLI entrypoint and executes the real binary with an isolated HOME to verify help/version/status behavior.
